description: After a task used an MCP server, report whether it worked (lookupd; structured fields only).

lookup_id.description: The lookup_id from the find_capability response that found this server, so the outcome ties to that search

session.description: A random id you make up once per conversation and repeat on every lookupd call in it, report_outcome included; never derived from the user, project or machine

step.description: Order in which this server was first used in the conversation

tool.description: The tool used most on the server, by name

name: report_outcome
